---
name: Task
about: One unit of build work an agent can claim and finish in a single PR
title: "<area>: <what>"
labels: task
---

## Goal
What this task must accomplish.

## PRD section
The section in the PRD column of `docs/REQUIREMENTS.md` for your requirement, e.g. "§4", or `n/a`.

## Requirement
Required: one id from `docs/REQUIREMENTS.md`, e.g. `REQ-WS-01` (add a row there first if none fits).

## Scope
Files/folders this touches; one area only.

## Acceptance check
A command that exits 0 when done; no "looks good".

## Depends on
Issue numbers, or "none".

## Area
`ios`, `backend`, or `contracts`.
